name: Azeroth Companion
title: LIVING WORLD ENGINE — The War Room & World Atlas
approval_note: The owner approved v16 development and Discord release. Physical iPhone, live Blizzard gameplay and historical visual baseline acceptance remain pending; new browser-smoke tests passed with synthetic local data.
features: Living War Room: a character-aware cinematic command station featuring your local roster, talent drafts, gear targets and next personal adventure.
Living World Atlas: a stylized interactive map with eight curated Azeroth regions, searchable cities/zones and links to existing research studios.
Command Search 2.0: fast browser-local lookup across studios, curated locations, saved characters, manual talent drafts, Item Atlas and personal missions.
Adventure Operations: create and manage zone goals linked to an optional character, native Forge draft and tracked item, with manual status and JSON export.
Connected Character Nexus: new World Atlas mission bridge, illustrated studio portals, and direct links throughout the original Companion.
Cinematic gold/violet visuals retain approved art, original Blizzard login, official spell icons, Talent Forge engine, music, saved builds and private backup tools.
Desktop and iPhone-style v16 browser scenarios passed; owner-approved Discord release continues with real-player and historical visual acceptance still pending.
